service.en: Change legal name of a real estate owner
service.ur: جائیداد کے مالک کے قانونی نام میں تبدیلی
service.ml: റിയൽ എസ്റ്റേറ്റ് ഉടമയുടെ നിയമപരമായ പേര് മാറ്റൽ

about: Change the name of a property owner or company based on a court letter or a residency administration letter.
aliases: Change owner name on title deed
note: Requirements read from the public TAMM service page on the checked date. TAMM fills the form in after UAE PASS sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

channels: TAMM website or app (sign in with UAE PASS)
